selected_evidence.requirement: Configure `/srv/drop` as shared writable while preventing users from removing files owned by others
selected_evidence.summary: Shows root ownership and mode 1777, successful writes by distinct users, cross-user deletion denied with `Operation not permitted`, owner deletion succeeding, and the final empty directory state.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed post-restart boot ID, persisted marker hash/content, retained mode 1777, and successful post-restart behavioral testing.

commands.command:
set -eu
user_a="dropa$$"
user_b="dropb$$"
file_a="/srv/drop/${user_a}.txt"
file_b="/srv/drop/${user_b}.txt"
cleanup() {
  sudo -n rm -f "$file_a" "$file_b"
  sudo -n userdel "$user_a" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sudo -n userdel "$user_b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
sudo -n useradd -M "$user_a"
sudo -n useradd -M "$user_b"
sudo -n -u "$user_a" sh -c "printf 'owned by %s\n' '$user_a' > '$file_a'"
sudo -n -u "$user_b" sh -c "printf 'owned by %s\n' '$user_b' > '$file_b'"
printf 'created_by_distinct_users:\n'
stat -c 'owner=%U mode=%a path=%n' "$file_a" "$file_b"
set +e
cross_error=$(sudo -n -u "$user_b" rm "$file_a" 2>&1)
cross_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'cross_user_delete_rc=%s\n' "$cross_rc"
printf 'cross_user_delete_error=%s\n' "$cross_error"
if [ "$cross_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf 'ERROR: sticky deletion protection failed\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ -f "$file_a" ]
printf 'protected_file_still_exists=yes\n'
sudo -n -u "$user_a" rm "$file_a"
sudo -n -u "$user_b" rm "$file_b"
printf 'owners_can_remove_own_files=yes\n'
stat -c 'directory_mode=%a directory_perms=%A owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/drop
commands.stdout:
created_by_distinct_users:
owner=dropa1915 mode=644 path=/srv/drop/dropa1915.txt
owner=dropb1915 mode=644 path=/srv/drop/dropb1915.txt
cross_user_delete_rc=1
cross_user_delete_error=rm: cannot remove ‘/srv/drop/dropa1915.txt’: Operation not permitted
protected_file_still_exists=yes
owners_can_remove_own_files=yes
directory_mode=1777 directory_perms=drwxrwxrwt owner=root group=root path=/srv/drop
